title: Reuse the provisioned Vulkan SDK for temporary baseline sources
body: The queued baseline configure extracted Vulkan SDK 1.4.350.1 into .tmp/baseline-846/VIXEN/.vulkan-sdk although the lane already had the same SDK at VIXEN/.vulkan-sdk. ProvisionVulkan defaults its cache under each source root. Suggested consolidation: let baseline capture setup reuse a shared persistent Vulkan cache.

title: Include repository-root tools in baseline capture archives
body: The queued baseline vixen_wsl_capture_witness failed before launch because its registered path VIXEN/../tools/run-vixen-windowed-captures.sh was absent from an archive containing only VIXEN. I restored tools/ from exact base commit 846ab1a9 and the witness passed. Suggested consolidation: make baseline capture setup archive the repository root inputs or resolve the helper from the lane tree.

title: Separate mutable FetchContent outputs across independent VIXEN build trees
body: The baseline and candidate both used VIXEN_FETCHCONTENT_CACHE=.tmp/fetch. After baseline configure/build, the candidate no-op command reconfigured and ran 1076 build steps; a second invocation was clean. Suggested consolidation: share downloaded sources while isolating build/configure outputs per CMake binary tree.

title: Provide a worktree-local artifact preset for standalone CodegenTool runs
body: The requested direct CodegenTool restore/build/check used the pinned project under the global kernel cache. I passed --artifacts-path .tmp/codegen-artifacts to keep generated bin/obj outputs inside this lane. Suggested consolidation: expose a documented lane-local CodegenTool artifact preset for standalone restore/build/run checks.

title: Calibrate the queue estimate for cold full VIXEN builds
body: The queued candidate Release build emitted its running-long warning at 2414 seconds with an expected duration of 600 seconds and completed at 4291 seconds. Suggested consolidation: use a separate cold full-build estimate for the laptop profile so long witnesses are scheduled and monitored accurately.

title: Document the required SPT category tag in worker proposal instructions
body: The prescribed proposal form with only --tag consolidation returned task proposals need at least one declared category. Adding --tag velocity allowed the proposal to be recorded. Suggested consolidation: show a declared category alongside consolidation in the worker rule example.
